citations.desc: Cleaning, sanitization, housekeeping, and pest control.
citations.narrative:
The facility doesn’t have an adequate pest control program for the building that contains birds. During the inspection,
numerous flies were seen in and around the bird enclosures and old bird feed. There was also an accumulation of dead
flies as well. While the facility does put out fly repellant, it is not effective in managing the fly population.
Pests, such as flies, can spread disease and contaminate food, surfaces, and animal housing areas. A safe and effective
program for the control of insects, ectoparasites, and avian and mammalian pests must be established and maintained to
promote the health and well-being of the birds and reduce contamination by pests in animal areas.
To be corrected by August 10, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
Additional Inspectors:
CODY YAGER
Michael Tygart, VETERINARY MEDICAL OFFICER n

flies as well. While the facility does put out fly repellant, it is not effective in managing the fly population. 
 
Pests, such as flies, can spread disease and contaminate food, surfaces, and animal housing areas. A safe and effective 
program for the control of insects, ectoparasites, and avian and mammalian pests must be established and maintained to 
promote the health and well-being of the birds and reduce contamination by pests in animal areas.
